## Columns

- **since**: first release tag whose `field_table.rs` has the row; `<=0.1.22` means the row was in the table when it was created (the key may be older; see `CHANGELOG.md`).
- **readers**: pattern hits, test code excluded. `chk` rlm `check/src` (the rules `play_launch check` runs); `drv` rlm `derive/src`, `sched/src`; `pl` play_launch `src/ros-launch-resolve/resolve/src` minus the model builder (a copy, not a read) and the explain files; `exp` play_launch `verbs/check.rs` and `ros/budget_book.rs` (the `--explain` tables); `rt` play_launch `src/play_launch/src` (launch, runtime enforcement); `ncg` nano-ros `packages/cli` (code generation, sizing); `nrt` the rest of nano-ros `packages` (runtime). nano-ros reads rlm at the tag its `Cargo.toml` pins, so a key added after that tag cannot have a nano-ros reader yet.
- A row marked *shared* has a field name another context also uses; its reader count is an upper bound. The analysis below resolves the ones that matter by reading the code.
- **writers**: occurrences in contracts, per repository (`pl` play_launch, `rlm`, `island`, `nros`); **forms** are the value shapes written (scalar / map / list).
